business_profile.primary_goal: qualify leads and book product demos

phase_1_greeting.default_text: Hi! 👋 Thanks for reaching out to {business_name}. To point you in the right direction — what's your industry, and what's the biggest bottleneck your team is facing right now?

phase_2_value_drop.default_text: Got it — that sounds like a great fit for our solution. 🚀

phase_3_cta.default_text: Would you like me to send over our direct booking link to schedule a brief 15-minute demo with an engineer this week? 📅

human_handoff_message.default_text: Thanks for your patience — I'm connecting you with a member of our team who can help further. They'll be with you shortly!

out_of_scope_message.default_text: That's a bit outside what I can help with directly — but I'd love to get you to someone on our team who can. Want me to connect you?
